pin.title: MEININGER Hotel Paris Porte de Vincennes Opens
pin.productName: MEININGER Hotel Paris Porte de Vincennes
pin.description: A budget hybrid hotel in eastern Paris, with private family rooms, a shared guest kitchen and common areas, suited to travellers willing to allow transit time to central sights.
pin.dateConfidenceReasoning: MEININGER’s subsequent Lyon opening release explicitly dates its French market entry and Paris Porte de Vincennes opening to 9 October 2019. This operator milestone is separate from Covivio’s ceremonial inauguration on 13 November 2019, whose project sheet says open since October.

pin.longFormSummary:
A budget hybrid hotel in eastern Paris, with private family rooms, a shared guest kitchen and common areas, suited to travellers willing to allow transit time to central sights.

Family and budget stay

Choose a private family room and confirm its exact beds, occupancy and any cot requirements. The operator lists a shared guest kitchen and common areas. An individual bed in a shared dorm is a different booking product from a whole private room.

The hotel is on Boulevard Carnot in the 12th arrondissement near the eastern edge of Paris. Check your walking and public-transport route to the sights you want to visit, and compare the full private-room cost with taxes, breakfast, parking and other extras.

Review tradeoffs

The opened Tripadvisor snapshot has 314 reviews, with an overall 3.6/5 rating and Cleanliness 3.4/5. Read recent comments about housekeeping, service and noise before booking. These figures describe a dated research snapshot rather than live scores.

Opening and project investment

The operator records the Paris opening milestone on 9 October 2019. The owner’s formal inauguration followed on 13 November; these are separate events.

Covivio’s project sheet reports 249 rooms, 946 beds and €47 million invested in the Paris Porte de Vincennes hotel. This is the reported development investment, not a nightly room rate, and is not assigned to the separate Lyon hotel.

hotel.basis: Read 2026-11-22: Tripadvisor UK snapshot, 314 reviews, Rooms 3.5, Service 3.7, Location 3.7, Cleanliness 3.4, Value 3.8 out of five, rounded to nearest half step. Overall 3.6/5 and housekeeping tradeoffs retained in article. Counts are snapshots, not live totals. English firsthand Eva review displayed February 2026 without exact publication day; date null. MICHELIN Paris first page covers 48 of 154 hotels, incomplete pagination; no property distinction verified, acclaim null. Forbes Paris directory read without MEININGER match. AAA geographic program excludes France.

pin.longFormSummary:
A knights-and-wizards themed family hotel at LEGOLAND Windsor, with separate children’s sleeping areas, in-room treasure hunts and access to selected shared resort facilities.

Family stay

Choose a Knight’s or Wizard’s room and confirm the precise bed layout, occupancy and current package inclusions. Check park operating dates, tickets, early access and any activity conditions for the stay you book.

The operator describes access to facilities in the LEGOLAND Resort Hotel next door, including the indoor water-play area and swimming pool, and a Playroom for hotel families. Check their current access rules, opening hours and reservation requirements.

Review context

A July 2017 firsthand family launch-preview review describes themed details and the in-room quest. Its historic menus, rates and early-ride arrangements are not current booking promises.

The opened Tripadvisor snapshot has 469 reviews and a Value component of 3.2/5. Compare the full package cost and read recent comments about room upkeep, housekeeping and service alongside the themed attractions.

Opening and construction project

Contemporary coverage reports that the Castle Hotel opened to guests on 1 July 2017. The original LEGOLAND Resort Hotel next door has its own accommodation and shared facilities.

Main contractor McGoff describes a £10 million project with 61 themed bedrooms. Its stated scope includes the Castle Hotel, restaurant and bar work, changes to existing reception and dining areas, and associated external works. The figure is the contractor-reported project value, not a confirmed all-in resort investment or a nightly rate.
